text:
Predicates:
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x is born in y.
American(x) ::: x is American.
Writer(x) ::: x is a writer.
WrittenBy(x, y) ::: x is written by y.
NovelWriter(x) ::: x is a novel writer.
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
City(x) ::: x is a city.
FOL ::: ¬Podcast(x) ∨ ¬Novel(x)
FOL ::: BornIn(x, y) ∧ City(y) ∧ American(y) → American(x)
FOL ::: Novel(x) ∧ WrittenBy(x, y) → Writer(y)
FOL ::: Novel(x) ∧ WrittenBy(x, y) → NovelWriter(y)
FOL ::: Writer(dani) ∧ American(dani)
FOL ::: WrittenBy(familyHistory, dani)
FOL ::: Novel(familyHistory)
FOL ::: WrittenBy(familyHistory, dani) ∧ Novel(familyHistory) → NovelWriter(dani)
FOL ::: Created(dani, familySecrets) ∧ Podcast(familySecrets)
FOL ::: City(boston) ∧ American(boston)

Premises:
¬(Podcast(x) ∧ Novel(x)) ::: A podcast is not a novel.
BornIn(x, y) ∧ City(y) ∧ American(y) → American(x) ::: If a person is born in American City, the person is American.
(Novel(x) ∧ WrittenBy(x, y)) → NovelWriter(y) ::: If a book is novel and it is written by a person, then the person is a novel writer.
Writer(dani) ∧ American(dani) ::: Dani Shapiro is an American writer.
WrittenBy(familyHistory, dani) ::: Family History is written by Dani Shapiro.
Novel(familyHistory) ∧ Publish(familyHistory, 2003) ::: Family History is a novel written in 2003.
Created(dani, familySecrets) ∧ Podcast(familySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created a podcast called Family Secrets.
City(boston) ∧ American(boston) ::: Boston is an American city.

Conclusion:
BornIn(dani, boston) ::: Dani Shapiro was born in Boston.
